title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 65-68 (Pushti, Shiva, Shivakari, Sati)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 65 to 68: Pushti, Shiva, Shivakari, Sati, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 65 to 68 with meaning
caption: Names 65 to 68 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 65 to 68**: **Pushti, Shiva, Shivakari, Sati**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Pushti, Shiva, Shivakari, Sati.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Pushti** means **Nourishment**. Sri Suktam: 'ardram pushkarinim pushtim', she who nourishes.
**Shiva** means **The Auspicious One**. Auspicious; the word also names Parvati, showing the oneness of the Devi.
**Shivakari** means **Bringer of auspiciousness**. One who brings auspiciousness into homes and lives.
**Sati** means **The True One**. The true and steadfast one; also a faithful consort.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
